# Deliveries

Part of the **Inventory** API. Base URL `https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1` — replace the host with your own installation and the token placeholder with a real Bearer token (see [Authentication](/master/api-reference/authentication)).

## List deliveries

<Badge type="tip" text="GET" /> `/admin/api/v1/inventories/deliveries`

Retrieve a paginated list of deliveries

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.


**Query parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|---------|
| `include` | string | No | Comma-separated list of relationships to include | `operationType,moves` |
| `filter[id]` | string | No | Filter by delivery IDs | `1,2` |
| `filter[name]` | string | No | Filter by delivery name | `WH/OUT/0001` |
| `filter[state]` | string | No | Filter by delivery state | `draft` |
| `filter[move_type]` | string | No | Filter by move type | `direct` |
| `filter[partner_id]` | string | No | Filter by partner IDs | `1,2` |
| `filter[user_id]` | string | No | Filter by responsible user IDs | `1,2` |
| `filter[company_id]` | string | No | Filter by company IDs | `1,2` |
| `filter[operation_type_id]` | string | No | Filter by operation type IDs | `1,2` |
| `sort` | string | No | Sort field | `-created_at` |
| `page` | integer | No | Page number | `1` |



::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X GET "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/inventories/deliveries?include=operationType%2Cmoves&filter%5Bid%5D=1%2C2&filter%5Bname%5D=WH%2FOUT%2F0001&filter%5Bstate%5D=draft&filter%5Bmove_type%5D=direct&filter%5Bpartner_id%5D=1%2C2&filter%5Buser_id%5D=1%2C2&filter%5Bcompany_id%5D=1%2C2&filter%5Boperation_type_id%5D=1%2C2&sort=-created_at&page=1" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

## Create delivery

<Badge type="tip" text="POST" /> `/admin/api/v1/inventories/deliveries`

Create a new delivery

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.



**Body parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `partner_id` | integer | No | Partner ID (receive from, contact, or delivery address based on operation type). Must match an existing stored value. |
| `operation_type_id` | integer | No | Operation type ID. If omitted, the API resolves the default operation type for the resource. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `source_location_id` | integer | No | Source location ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `destination_location_id` | integer | No | Destination location ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `user_id` | integer | No | Responsible user ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `move_type` | string | No | Shipping policy. |
| `scheduled_at` | string | No | Scheduled datetime. Must be a valid date. |
| `origin` | string | No | Source document reference. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `description` | string | No | Operation note. |
| `moves` | object[] | No | Optional operation moves payload. |
| `moves[].id` | integer | No | Must match an existing stored value. |
| `moves[].product_id` | integer | Yes | Must match an existing stored value. |
| `moves[].product_uom_qty` | number | Yes | Must be at least 0. Must not be greater than 99999999999. |
| `moves[].uom_id` | integer | No | Must match an existing stored value. |
| `moves[].final_location_id` | integer | No | Must match an existing stored value. |
| `moves[].description_picking` | string | No | Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `moves[].scheduled_at` | string | No | Must be a valid date. |
| `moves[].deadline` | string | No | Must be a valid date. |
| `moves[].product_packaging_id` | integer | No | Must match an existing stored value. |
| `moves[].quantity` | number | No | Must be at least 0. Must not be greater than 99999999999. |
| `moves[].is_picked` | boolean | No |  |


::: code-group

```bash [cURL]

  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \

  "partner_id": 1,

    }
  ]
}'
```
